content:
YouTuber Marques Brownlee (MKBHD) posted a new video today where he lists the top 10 products he wishes Apple would make. And the good news is, many of those products are rumored for Apple’s roadmap.

MKBHD’s list of 10 Apple products he wants to exist

Apple says “no” to far more product ideas than it says “yes” to. But if Marques Brownlee had his way, there would be at least 10 more Apple products available today.

Here is MKBHD’s top 10 most wanted Apple products that don’t exist:

  • Car
  • Camera
  • Fitness band with no screen
  • AR glasses
  • Smart doorbell or security camera
  • Home hub with a screen
  • Siri “that’s actually good”
  • MacBook with cellular
  • Folding iPhone
  • Printer

Fortunately, rumors indicate that about half of these products are actually in the works right now.

iPhone Ultra will launch this September as Apple’s first foldable iPhone, and the HomePad / HomePod Touch is expected this fall too. AR glasses and a security camera are also in the works. And possibly we’ll get cellular in the MacBook Ultra.

Top comment by J Dubs

With foreign made wireless routers being banned, this is the perfect opportunity for Apple to bring back Airport routers made in the USA.

But before all of that, hopefully next week we’ll get a “Siri that’s actually good.”
